description: VYBE Music v4.1.1 — Listen Together Real-Time Playback Synchronization with Beat Sync drift micro-adjustment, restored guest play/pause controls, latency-compensated joins, and stability enhancements.
changelog: Listen Together: Instant real-time playback sync (Play, Pause, Resume, Seek, and Track Change) across all room members
Listen Together Beat Sync: Micro-speed adjustment (1.03x / 0.97x) seamlessly prevents audio drift and echoes without clicks
Restored normal Play/Pause buttons in Player & Mini Player (removed confusing mute toggle icon for guests)
Room creation defaults to allowing participant playback control for seamless collaborative sessions
Heartbeat sync interval tightened to 2 seconds with sub-second latency compensation
Initial join & reconnect sync immediately starts local playback at the host's exact elapsed position
Recap 9:16 Instagram Story & WhatsApp HD Image Export with Google card branding
Seasonal Themes for Recap (Winter Chill, Spring Groove, Summer Vybe, Autumn Warmth)
Listen Together Live Floating Emoji Reactions (🔥, ❤️, 👏, ⚡, 💃) synced across all room listeners
Smart Sleep Timer with gentle 30-second volume fade-out
Accent-tinted offline badges for downloaded music
Background GitHub automatic update checker on launch with system notifications
Complete rebrand of all app strings, widgets, and themes to VYBE Music
Fixed cellular playback IO_UNSPECIFIED (2000) with browser User-Agent and NewPipe direct stream fallback
Resolved cellular network search and explore hanging with IPv4-first DNS
Home screen launch pinned strictly at top showing 3x3 Speed Dial
Dice roll now shuffles fresh music and automatically starts playing
Fixed Spotify WebView Google login and Liked Songs import
Listen Together autoplay sync fixed for joined members (player prepare + playWhenReady)
Admin Portal secured with 6-digit PIN (262007) and restricted to authorized admin email only
Live install and download tracker added in Admin Portal
Added Buy Me a Coffee Support Dialog with 1-tap Copy UPI ID (reddyabcr07@ybl)
